commonMistakes.when: hot crucible is placed on the balance
commonMistakes.message: A hot crucible should not be weighed.

commonMistakes.when: final mass is recorded after one heating only
commonMistakes.message: Thermal decomposition should be checked by reheating to constant mass.
commonMistakes.recovery: Repeat heat, cool, and weigh before recording the final mass.
